subject: Discovery recap: POC success metrics & prompt/log harvest plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearsight.ai>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: POC success metrics & prompt/log harvest plan

Hi Samira and Carlos —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff:

1) High-level goal (what success looks like)
   - Reduce average hallucination/error rate on clinical note classification to <3% on the evaluation set
   - Maintain 95th percentile generation latency under 300ms for the interactive use-case
   - Demonstrate token-cost reduction strategies with <10% drop in F1 vs baseline

2) What we need from Acme to run the eval and build prompts
   - Prompt/log dataset: ~5k representative user prompts + expected ground-truth answers (CSV)
   - 2 weeks of live request logs (anonymized) or a sampled export with user-level identifiers removed
   - A small set (20–50) of "failure case" examples you care most about (edge cases)

3) Security & transfer
   - Preferred transfer: S3 bucket (we can provide IAM role) or Upload to the shared Drive link below
   - If you need a DPA/SSH transfer, we can accelerate — see docsend link in Related links

4) Timeline (proposed)
   - By 2026-10-27: Acme provides sample dataset + logging sample
   - 2026-10-28 – 2026-11-04: Redwood ingests & runs initial eval; deliver 1st readout
   - Week of 2026-11-08: Joint readout + decision on next steps (scale pilot / tuning)

5) Owners
   - Redwood: Ben (sales lead) / Karthik (modeling & eval lead) / Monica (CS/onboarding)
   - Acme: Samira (product owner) / Carlos (security contact)

Attachment: redwood_poc_checklist.pdf (PDF, 420KB) — contains sample schema, anonymization checklist, and ingestion instructions.

Ask: Can you confirm the preferred transfer method and whether the data will be anonymized by your team or if you want Redwood to apply a scrub step? If we can get the sample files by next Wednesday (10/27), we’ll hit the timeline above.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@clearsight.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: POC success metrics & prompt/log harvest plan

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick responses inline and next steps from our side: 

- Transfer method: We prefer S3 with a temporary IAM role. I can provision a bucket and share the ARN if that works.
- Anonymization: Our security team will strip direct identifiers (names, SSNs) but will leave pseudonymous IDs so you can measure session continuity. If Redwood has a recommended scrub script, we’re open to that as a second pass.
- Sample content: attaching a small export (acme_prompt_samples.csv) with 1200 anonymized prompts and labels — this is a view into the larger set. The file contains columns: prompt_text, user_role, ground_truth_label, timestamp, session_id.
- Constraints: A subset of the logs contain redactable PHI in free text; we’ll flag those rows in a separate file.

We can meet the 10/27 sample date but may need to push the full 2-week log export to 11/1 (internal approvals). Is that acceptable for the kickoff cadence?

Attachment: acme_prompt_samples.csv (CSV, 230KB)

On Wed, Oct 20, 2026 at 3:02 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samira and Carlos —
> 
> Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff:
> ...

Best,
Samira
Senior Product Manager
Clearsight / Acme Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: POC success metrics & prompt/log harvest plan

Samira — great, thanks for the samples and the clarity on anonymization. That timeline works; we’ll adapt the initial ingest step to accept a smaller sample first and then the full log export on 11/01.

Action items / owners (from Redwood side):
- Karthik Iyer: lead on eval metric definitions (precision/recall thresholds, hallucination checks), target start 10/28
- Monica Patel: onboarding & S3 role setup, will send IAM steps + shared Drive fallback by 10/23
- Ben Carter: commercial & success criteria owner (point person for contract/DPA)

Requested deliverables from Acme:
- By 2026-10-27: acme_prompt_samples.csv (received) + note on PHI rows (you mentioned flagged rows)
- By 2026-11-01: 2-week log export (anonymized) or S3 access for Redwood
- Failure cases doc (20–50 examples) — if you have these as a shared doc, drop the link or attach as a CSV

Doc/Links: I’ll share a short onboarding checklist and the HubSpot deal record after this thread. If you prefer, we can also run a quick 30-minute technical sync on 10/26 to walk through the sample schema and anonymization approach.

Ben

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearsight.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: POC success metrics & prompt/log harvest plan

Hi all — looping in the onboarding checklist and a few practical items to avoid delays. Please see the short checklist below and confirm when the bucket ARN is available so I can attach the IAM role.

POC ingest checklist (short):
- Confirm S3 bucket ARN or grant folder on Drive
- Confirm sample schema (we received acme_prompt_samples.csv and validated columns)
- Provide list of flagged PHI rows (we will exclude by default unless instructed)
- Provide preferred contact for security review (Carlos listed)
- Confirm time for 10/26 technical sync (suggest 10:30am PT)

Attachment: poc_prompt_ingest_instructions.md — contains step-by-step for IAM role, sample manifest format, and recommended anonymization regex snippets.

I’ll also create a HubSpot task and calendar event for the 10/26 sync and share the invites. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Monica
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
